boxes.text: Let your quinces be full ripe, then wipe them, & pare them, & Quarter them,
then take out the Cores and seeds, & boil the Parcings & seeds in Spring water,
strain the Liquor, & weigh your Quinces, with the same weight of dry L. Sugar,
boil the Quince, in that Liquor, & when Tender, mash them,
& then put your sug.r to the Quinces, & boil it till it Looks red & smooth,
keeping it stirred all The time it Boils
